_note: Written after looking at the screenshots and before any grading. Not changed afterwards.

menu/m_excellent: Grid rebuild; only sub-pixel spacing and a few px of width differ.
menu/m_good: Right page; dollar signs added, dotted leaders gone, logo a bit smaller, one dish description reworded.
menu/m_mediocre: Same menu but a green hero band, Arial, two-column dishes and big orange headings; two prices wrong and Affogato missing.
menu/m_poor: Default Times bullet list, half the prices missing, nothing of the look.
menu/m_prices_wrong: Looks perfect but six of fifteen prices are wrong: a menu you cannot print.
menu/m_shifted: Identical except the header has 70px more top padding; a boss shrugs.
menu/m_course_order: Every dish right but desserts come first and starters last: one obvious flaw.
menu/cheat_hidden_text: Visible page is a logo and 'Menu coming soon'; the real menu is covered.
menu/cheat_shuffled: Right look but dish names scrambled, names and prices reassigned at random: nonsense content.
menu/cheat_camouflage: Only the logo and a decoy line are visible; the menu is written in the background colour.
signup/s_excellent: Indistinguishable apart from a hand-drawn checkbox and select arrow.
signup/s_good: Right screen; panel flat blue, quote and password hint gone, indigo button, taller inputs.
signup/s_mediocre: Generic centred card on grey; brand panel reduced to a bar, company size missing, '30-day' trial wrong.
signup/s_poor: Unstyled browser form with three inputs.
signup/s_wrong_purpose: Looks identical but it is a sign-in screen: heading, subtitle, button and footer link say the wrong thing.
signup/s_other_blue: Identical except the panel gradient is teal-to-navy the other way; a boss barely minds.
signup/s_no_password: Right screen with the password field missing: a sign-up form that cannot work.
signup/cheat_duplicated: The whole screen shown twice, one below the other: obviously broken though the top half is perfect.
signup/cheat_boxes: Right colours and boxes, every word replaced by grey bars.
invoice/i_excellent: Grid rebuild of the table; indistinguishable at a glance.
invoice/i_good: Right invoice; numeric dates without labels column, 'Price' header, status pill gone, square logo.
invoice/i_mediocre: Plain full-width page, teal header row, code column, ship-to and one line item gone.
invoice/i_poor: Bare bordered table with five of eight lines and a total.
invoice/i_numbers_wrong: Looks perfect but two line amounts and the total due are wrong: the one thing an invoice must get right.
invoice/i_roomy: Same invoice with roomier rows and a mint header row; a boss shrugs.
invoice/i_cols_swapped: Qty and Unit price columns swapped, values follow their headers; a small oddity.
invoice/cheat_top_only: Header and addresses only; table, totals and notes missing.
invoice/cheat_tiny_text: Right frame and teal bar, every word 2px high and unreadable.
invoice/cheat_picture_text: A screenshot of the goal as a background with the real words made transparent: no work done.
product/p_excellent: Grid rebuild; indistinguishable at a glance.
product/p_good: Right page; reviews as a list instead of cards, three related cards not four, no wishlist button or perks.
product/p_mediocre: Single centred column, tabs and related products gone, price and rating wrong, orange pill button.
product/p_poor: A grey square, 'Backpack', a price and a button.
product/p_wrong_product: Looks right but the picture is a shoe and the price is $194 not $149.
product/p_sold_out: Looks right but the button says 'Sold out' and the stock line says unavailable.
product/p_mirrored: Image and buy box swapped sides; everything else right.
product/cheat_lorem: Right look, every word replaced by lorem ipsum.
product/cheat_picture: One screenshot of the goal as an image; no text, no build.
